blocking_issues: The full original finding/companion panel is not numerically closed: the listed source scalar summaries omit still-unfrozen indexed distribution, condition, regional, clustering and bilateral coordinates. Full-panel identity manifests and complete finding IDs are required before any result admission; these omissions cannot become an easier replacement panel.

Released H13 Split 1 has four components and an unresolved export mismatch; two SWCs lack author section labels. The notebook reloads Size without the earlier radius-to-diameter conversion. Selecting a favorable component, excluding the discrepant cell, inventing labels or choosing the better-fitting convention does not reproduce the original procedure.

Source manuscript summaries and analysis labels need reconciliation: spine-density abstract/Results values differ, and notebook figure/supplement numbering differs from final article numbering. No silent version or endpoint substitution is admitted.

Manual width, height, compartment and fractal inputs, source orientations, spine/neurite memberships and exclusions, putative fiber-contact classifications, regional specimen/lobule coordinates and source shuffle realizations lack a complete authenticated original-data-to-output join.

No source-grounded numerical reproduction tolerance or equivalence/uncertainty rule has been admitted. Published SDs, rounded displays, significance stars, nonrejection and the local 0.001 post-inspection QC threshold are not reproduction tolerances.

The current submitted-program interface and numerical verifier cover a ten-tree reconstruction profile only. Source-native granular output schemas, independent verification and immutable observation/metric/aggregation identities for all original paper panels are absent.

The accepted input preparer has generated and source-text controls but authentic archive-to-all-input preparation remains unrun. Optional historical article provisioning, complete matched A/B exposure, runtime/resource ownership and whole-paper common inputs are not qualified.

Mouse cell-to-individual mapping is unavailable for the reconstructed-cell panel; branches/spines/cells, shuffles and technical repetitions must not become independent donors. The original spine and regional cohorts differ from the ten reconstructed cells.

Putative anatomical climbing-fiber contacts and covariation with functional regions cannot be reinterpreted as physiological proof of independent dendritic computation or causal functional specialization.
eligibility_reason: The original descriptive anatomy is a meaningful first-class reproduction objective independently of its ineligible improvement direction. Source summary targets and original panel obligations can be identified, but original-procedure fidelity, complete indexed findings/controls, source-native verification and agreement/uncertainty rules remain unresolved. Existing ten-tree reconstruction and authoring/software controls do not establish AI reproduction of the original findings.

aggregation.description: Source morphology summaries group cells/species and compare anatomical distributions; donor-level interpretation must respect the three-human/two-mouse sampling hierarchy. Branches and spines are not independent donors. Local equal-cell RMSE only measures reconstruction.

cohort.description: Figure 1: five reconstructed Purkinje cells per species from three human and two mouse individuals. Spine and regional panels have their own sampling designs and must not be collapsed into these ten cells.

dataset.description: Author morphology archive Zenodo 15066697 v3 with dendrite, spine/neurite and regional slice reconstructions and RMarkdown/MATLAB analysis. The source archive defines distinct panel inputs; the local ten-SWC subset is not the entire paper.

full_panel.description: The required original panel comprises Figure 1C-R and morphology supplements; Figure 2B-H/J-O and spine supplements; Figure 3 putative fiber-contact classification with its reconstruction controls; Figures 4-6 and regional supplements, including morphology/orientation strata, observed-versus-shuffled adjacency and spatial/shell clustering, and within-individual bilateral comparisons. Complete specimen/condition/order/radius/puncta/lobule coordinates, original numerical targets and final-article-to-notebook supplement joins are not frozen. The scalar targets listed here are identifiable published summaries, not closure of this complete indexed panel.

inputs.description: Dendritic tree reconstructions and their annotations, Sholl summaries, spine/neurite measurements and regional slice reconstructions appropriate to each source panel.

metric.description: Dendritic length, branch count/order, arbor dimensions, diameter, Sholl profiles and spine/regional contrasts. These describe anatomy; greater species difference, more branching or a smaller p-value is not method-performance improvement.

permitted_observations.description: Paper and original panel-specific public observations are common inputs; original author code is the only intended addition in the second condition. Existing A16/B18 packets share ten raw SWCs, cell metadata, answer-bearing author Sholl totals and the article; B adds the original Rmd and source excerpts. The shared specification is source-informed and these are exposed development observations. Whole-paper data/image/annotation manifests, actual matched exposure, cumulative budgets and the current protected participant execution boundary are not qualified.

preprocessing.description: Author RMarkdown provides reconstruction joins and branch/section calculations, but the local audit records an unresolved H13Split1 export mismatch and radius-to-diameter state ambiguity. Neither dropping the cell nor choosing the convention best matching the paper recovers an exact source procedure.

split.description: The source performs comparative anatomical estimation on measured specimens; it does not designate train/validation/test sets for an ordered predictive endpoint. Local retrospective source-consistency filtering is not a held-out split.

target.description: Species differences in Purkinje dendritic geometry, branching, Sholl profiles and spines, plus regional distribution of multi-compartment cells. These are measured biological estimands.

source_paper.title: Non-allometric expansion and enhanced compartmentalization of Purkinje cell dendrites in the human cerebellum
